terms.comment: Hōc modō, eōdem modō, ad hunc modum: “in this way, in the same way, like this”; servōrum modō, “in the manner of slaves”. Also “measure, limit”. “Manners” (behaviour) are mōrēs (see well-behaved).
The way something is planned or reasoned out (see approach).

phrases.english: make the floors in this manner

phrases.latin: meminī super Pindarō poētā et Vergiliō in hunc fermē modum disserere
phrases.english: I remember him discussing Pindar and Virgil roughly in this manner

sources: Lewis & Short: modus · Lewis & Short: ratio
Quotations from the Latinitas loci collections (loci-cato, loci-gellius), checked against the editions named there.
